headline: ➖ Industrials & Infrastructure dropped out of the book
detail: Industrials & Infrastructure is no longer held in the HK rotation book.
headline_zh: ➖ Industrials & Infrastructure 移出建议组合
detail_zh: Industrials & Infrastructure 已不在 HK 轮动组合中。

headline: 🔄 New rotation leader: Biotech, Pharma & CXO
detail: Biotech, Pharma & CXO took rotation leadership from Banks (H + HK).
detail_zh: Biotech, Pharma & CXO 取代 Banks (H + HK) 成为轮动领涨。

headline: 📉 Industrials & Infrastructure lost its trend gate
detail: Industrials & Infrastructure fell below its 200d trend — out of the eligible set.
detail_zh: Industrials & Infrastructure 跌破 200 日趋势 — 退出可选集合。

headline: 🔻 Risk dialed DOWN — cash 25% → 50%
detail: The suggested cash weight moved from 25% to 50% (breadth/trend driven).
detail_zh: 建议现金权重由 25% 变为 50%（广度/趋势驱动）。

headline: 🔄 New rotation leader: Insurers
detail: Insurers took rotation leadership from Biotech, Pharma & CXO.
detail_zh: Insurers 取代 Biotech, Pharma & CXO 成为轮动领涨。

headline: 🔄 New rotation leader: China Tech & Internet
detail: China Tech & Internet took rotation leadership from Insurers.
detail_zh: China Tech & Internet 取代 Insurers 成为轮动领涨。

headline: 📈 Conglomerates & Exchange reclaimed its trend
detail: Conglomerates & Exchange is back above its 200d trend — eligible for the book again.
headline_zh: 📈 Conglomerates & Exchange 重回趋势上方
detail_zh: Conglomerates & Exchange 重新站上 200 日趋势 — 再次具备入选资格。
